info.title: openIMIS FHIR R4 API
info.description: The FHIR R4 REST API of openIMIS, the open-source health insurance management system, served by the openimis-be-api_fhir_r4_py backend module at <host>/api/api_fhir_r4. openIMIS domain records are exposed as FHIR resources: insurees as Patient, families as Group, policies as Contract and Coverage, claims as Claim/ClaimResponse, products as InsurancePlan, medical items and services as Medication and ActivityDefinition, and openIMIS lookup tables as CodeSystem. A resource-type GET returns a searchset Bundle; a GET by id returns the resource itself. The OpenFn openimis adaptor authenticates with POST /login/ and then reaches any of these paths through getFHIR(path, params).

post.summary: Authenticate and obtain a bearer token
post.description: Exchanges openIMIS credentials for a JWT. The adaptor calls this first and sends the result as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every other request.

200.description: A JWT bearer token and its expiry.

get.description: Search an openIMIS insuree and return the matches as a FHIR searchset Bundle.

parameters.name: _count
parameters.description: Page size — the number of entries to return in the Bundle.

parameters.name: page-offset
parameters.description: Page number (1-based); openIMIS returns it in the Bundle `link` of relation `next`.

parameters.name: _format
parameters.description: Response representation; the adaptor always reads JSON.

parameters.name: identifier
